review: Our journey with Becka’s House started with a letter I wrote almost two years ago. I want to Thank Everyone there for taking a heartfelt interest in our daughter and believing and helping her on her journey of independence and growth. Everyone there showers us with kindness, grace and love. I know this is just the beginning of a lifelong friendship. Becka’s House has been a true blessing in ours and our daughter’s life. I know God’s hand is on this special home and He will continue to grow and bless you all and the work you are doing. We love you all and are excited to see what God has next for all of us in the future.
name: G. Lione, Plano Texas
